mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 2.5% triggers a preemptive equity risk premium, pushing S&P 500 forward returns positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 60-day window, 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (t-test p > 0.05) during inflation spikes above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS labor cost growth above 2% is associated with higher wage-price spirals, which elevates expected equity returns and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60-day windows where PAYEMS > 2%, 20-day forward returns are negative or flat on average (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 3% signals resilient demand, which lowers discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Over 100 instances where GDPC1 increases >3%, 20-day forward returns are negative (mean < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in INDPRO manufacturing index below 90 triggers supply-side weakness, increasing perceived equity risk and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During INDPRO < 90 periods, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (mean >= 0, p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25 percentage points in a month, the S&P 500 is expected to underperform over the next 60 trading days due to tightened financing conditions.
regime_hint: fiscal tightening or rate hike anticipation
failure_condition: In 100 such FEDFUNDS up moves >0.25%, 60-day forward returns are not statistically negative (mean >= 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in UNRATE above 4.5% indicates labor market tightening, which elevates real interest rates and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: During UNRATE > 4.5% periods, 20-day forward returns are not consistently negative (mean > 0 over 50% of such windows).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of RSAFS retail sales exceeding 1.5% above trend are associated with strong demand signals that produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: In 50 such RSAFS up months, 5-day forward returns are not positive (mean <= 0).

mechanism_narrative: Interaction between a decline in HOUST (industrial production) of at least 2% and a rise in FEDFUNDS of more than 0.1% simultaneously predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days due to dual supply and liquidity pressures.
candidate_trigger: HOUST < previous 12-mo and FEDFUNDS > previous 12-mo, with HOUST down >=2% and FEDFUNDS up >0.1%
regime_hint: concurrent supply contraction and monetary tightening
failure_condition: During such combined events, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (mean >= 0, p > 0.05).
